title: [docker-sonic-mgmt] [Scapy 2.4.5] Calling RawPcapReader for a pcap throws a NameError
author: lizhijianrd
body:

-->

#### Description

Current `scapy` version in docker image `sonic-mgmt` is `2.4.5` ([Dockerfile.j2](dockers/docker-sonic-mgmt/Dockerfile.j2)). This version contains a known issue: [Calling RawPcapReader for a pcap throws a NameError in scapy 2.4.5 #3179](https://github.com/secdev/scapy/issues/3179).

The fix PR [Hotfix: fix bad typing #3180](https://github.com/secdev/scapy/pull/3180) is released in `scapy==2.5.0`.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:

Run below script in `sonic-mgmt` container:

```python3
from scapy.utils import RawPcapReader

filename = 'dhcpv6-03mx.pcap'
for (pkt_data, pkt_metadata) in RawPcapReader(filename):
    pass
```

#### Describe the results you received:

Got below error:

```
$ python3 main.py
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "main.py", line 4, in <module>
    for (pkt_data, pkt_metadata) in RawPcapReader(filename):
  File "/home/zhijianli/.local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/scapy/utils.py", line 1241, in next
    return self.read_packet()
  File "/home/zhijianli/.local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/scapy/utils.py", line 1264, in read_packet
    Packet,
NameError: name 'Packet' is not defined
```

#### Describe the results you expected:

Expect `scapy` not throw this `NameError` exception.
